_about: Ban do giao tiep Modbus cua firmware OTL-06ALS, xuat de app mo phong may rang doc. Huong (direction) tinh theo goc nhin cua APP mo phong, KHONG phai firmware.

_direction_semantics.sim_provides: Firmware DOC register nay -> app phai cap gia tri (dau vao cua firmware, vd nhiet do).
_direction_semantics.sim_captures: Firmware GHI register nay -> app doc de chay model nhiet (dau ra cua firmware, vd gas%).
_direction_semantics.sim_serves: Register app giu trang thai, firmware co the doc hoac ghi.

_scaling.percent: x10 tren HMI bus (350 = 35.0 %); x1 tren Artisan slave

buses.name: sensor_bus
buses.role_of_app: Modbus SLAVE (app dong vai cac thiet bi ben duoi)

registers.name: BT_PV
registers.address: tempRegister (cau hinh runtime = iMemHMI[6], firmware doc 1 reg tu day)
registers.note: Firmware: nodeBT.readHoldingRegisters(tempRegister_R, 1). App tra BT*10 cho lan doc 1 reg nay, bat ke dia chi cu the.

registers.name: BT_SV
registers.note: Firmware ghi setpoint khi svEn. App co the bo qua khi mo phong.

registers.name: DRUM_FREQ_READ
registers.note: Tan so hien tai. App tra echo lenh.

registers.name: AIR_FREQ_READ
registers.note: Tan so quat gio hien tai.

registers.name: AIR_ACI_RAW
registers.note: Tin hieu analog ACI = cam bien CHAN KHONG (vacuum). App sinh ap suat gia tu air%.

buses.name: hmi_bus
buses.role_of_app: Modbus SLAVE (app dong vai HMI Delta, slave_id=1). Firmware la MASTER.

memory_blocks.iMemHMI: 60 reg ($M HMI) - control/config tu nut bam. Firmware DOC.
memory_blocks.dAddress: 500 reg (40xxx) - du lieu profile + hien thi. Firmware doc VA ghi.

registers_firmware_reads__SIM_PROVIDES_b.name: CHARGE_BTN
registers_firmware_reads__SIM_PROVIDES_b.note: Xi lanh charge - kich hoat moc thoi gian rang

registers_firmware_writes__SIM_CAPTURES_.name: BT_HMI
registers_firmware_writes__SIM_CAPTURES_.note: Firmware echo BT len HMI (chi de hien thi)

registers_firmware_writes__SIM_CAPTURES_.name: AIRFLOW_HMI
registers_firmware_writes__SIM_CAPTURES_.note: **App doc lam dau vao model nhiet (air%)**

registers_firmware_writes__SIM_CAPTURES_.name: GAS_HMI
registers_firmware_writes__SIM_CAPTURES_.note: **MAU CHOT: app doc lam dau vao model nhiet (gas%)**

buses.name: artisan_bus
buses.role_of_app: BO QUA khi mo phong may rang. Firmware la SLAVE o day (Artisan PC la master).
buses.note: Chi can neu test link Artisan. Cung UART voi debug -> xung dot khi enDebug.
